verdicts.title: A-infinity Algebras Derived from Associative Algebras with a Non-Derivation Differential
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Given an associative graded algebra equipped with a degree +1 differential we define an A-infinity structure that measures the failure of the differential to be a derivation. This can be seen as a non-commutative analog of generalized BV-algebras. verdicts.title: Topological spaces of persistence modules and their properties
